# Version choice: the DDFS/SENT to client folder contains transmittal .msg emails only (no standalone workbook); the final transmittal 'Latest DDFS and Summaries.msg' is dated 24 Nov 2025, same day as this file's last modification, and this is the only/most recent DesignDay_S25.xlsx in the engagement DDFS folder - so it is taken as the sent version.

# ANOMALY FLAG: the Cover sheet reads 'Design Day W31 - DRAFT' (24-Nov-25) although the file is DesignDay_S25; chart titles inside read 'Design Day SS 25' and DayBeforeArr covers services arriving 20 Jul 2025 / taking off 21 Jul 2025, confirming S25 content. Cover title appears to be a stale label.
# Year column: single design-day workbook (Summer 2025 design day, 21 Jul 2025); year = 2025 throughout, read from 'Design Day SS 25' chart labels and the 20/21 Jul 2025 schedule dates.

# StandDemand: three blocks (pax, cargo, pax & cargo) x ICAO classes A-F plus A+B+C+D+E+F. Pinned: Max Acft on ground, carried-in ATMs (arriving evening before and departing on DDFS day), Grand Total Arr/Dep ATMs per class, and hourly AOG (end of clock hour) for the A+B+C+D+E+F column of each block.

# DATA ODDITY FLAG: cargo class D 'Acft on ground' is -1 at hour 23 (recorded as printed). An unlabelled residual row follows the Grand Total row on StandDemand (pax C=2; cargo D=-1; pax&cargo C=3, D=-1, total 5); not extracted as it carries no label.

# DayBeforeArr: NO summary count table on the sheet - it is a flight-level ledger of 10 carried-in services; the count is pinned via the StandDemand carried-in row (pax C=10, total=10), which matches the ledger row count.

# Busy-hour: Clock_* sheets are clock-hour summaries. Pinned: Max per bound (Dep/Arr/Dep+Arr) for all six Clock_* sheets; full hourly values for Clock_Total_ATMs and Clock_Total_Seats. Hourly detail of Clock_Sch_*/Clock_ExtraSch_* present in source but not extracted (Max only).
# Thousands separators (e.g. 1,452) stripped; values otherwise as printed. Rolling 60-min chart-feed sheets (C1-C18) and Roll60Mins working sheet not extracted.
